INSERT INTO cohort_summary (cohort, size, example_comment)
SELECT 
    cohort,
    COUNT(*) as size,
    (SELECT contact_notes FROM participants p2 WHERE p2.cohort = p1.cohort AND p2.contact_notes IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) as example_comment
FROM participants p1
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort;
